People who use a screen reader often jump from link to link, or open a list of all links on the page. There, a link that reads "here" or "learn more" has no sentence around it, so nobody can tell where it goes.

Case, punctuation and extra spaces are ignored. An `aria-label` on the link or on an element inside it counts as its text, and so does the `alt` of an `img` inside it. Elements with `aria-hidden` don't.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jsx-a11y/anchor-ambiguous-text" = "error" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jsx-a11y/anchor-ambiguous-text" = ["error", {
  words = ["click here", "here", "link", "a link", "learn more"],
}]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 3} */}
```jsx
const pricing = <p>To see our prices, <a href="/pricing">click here</a>.</p>;
const docs = <a href="/docs">Learn more!</a>;
const home = <a href="/"><img src="/home.png" alt="link" /></a>;
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
const pricing = <p>See <a href="/pricing">our prices</a>.</p>;
const docs = <a href="/docs">Learn more about plugins</a>;
const home = <a href="/"><img src="/home.png" alt="Home page" /></a>;
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `words` | `["click here", "here", "link", "a link", "learn more"]` | The texts to report, in lower case. Your list replaces the default. |

{/* bad {"options": [{"words": ["read more"]}]} */}
```jsx
const more = <a href={post.url}>Read more</a>;
```

{/* good {"options": [{"words": ["read more"]}]} */}
```jsx
const pricing = <a href="/pricing">click here</a>;
```
